task.title: Check for Updates
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to check if a new version of TMXEditor is available.

context.p: TMXEditor checks for new versions automatically when the application starts. You can also check for updates manually at any time.

step.cmd: In main menu, select Help Check for Updates... .
step.stepresult: If a new version is available, the following dialog appears: Software Updates Dialog

step.cmd: Click the View Release History button to review what changed in the new version, or click the Download Update button to download it.

taskbody.result: Once the update is downloaded, follow the instructions provided for your platform to install the new version.
